message.content: On June 24, 2026, at 14:00, LiHua sends a video to the band group chat. The content of the message states, "Just sent a video of me playing the intro to "Stairway to Heaven." What do you think about trying out this classic? Would be awesome to jam on it together! 🤘" Based on the description provided, the video LiHua sends is of him playing the introduction to the famous song "Stairway to Heaven" by Led Zeppelin.
